title: Mountain long run, back-to-back day 1
terrain: mountain trail, ~180m D+, power-hike steep climbs, controlled descents

steps.target: Z2, 145-155bpm, power-hike climbs, cadence 174+ on flats

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: ~2h20, about 180m D+. Hike anything steep to stay under 155bpm, last 20min sustained climb at 160-166bpm, then easy descent.
GYM: none.
FUEL: 2 flasks Tailwind (500ml, 2 scoops each), one per hour from min 20, plus 1 Carbo Gel at ~1h30.
STOP RULE: skip the Z3 climb if Friday or Saturday-morning HRV is amber. Walk down if cadence falls under 165 or the quads are shot.
WHY: day 1 of a back-to-back long-run weekend, the specific stimulus for finishing strong on tired legs at VWT.
